name: gh (GitHub CLI)
description: GitHub's official command-line tool for issues, pull requests and releases.

version.description: Channel (latest), a release line (major or major.minor), or an exact version (major.minor.patch).

stateDir.description: If set, puts this feature's data at this path, which must be inside the remote user's home. Mount a volume there to persist it across rebuilds.

env.name: GH_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER
env.description: With any value, the daily release check stays off

env.name: GH_NO_EXTENSION_UPDATE_NOTIFIER
env.description: With any value, the extension release checks stay off

env.name: GH_CONFIG_DIR
env.description: gh's config and sign-in in the state dir
